title: Nine Seeds Behind the Wall
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：apple　|　正文 331 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 apple 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 my grandfather planted ① an apple tree behind the wall and said it would outlive him, and it did by nine years. The ② apple, meaning the fruit and not the tree, was small and hard and kept until March; an apple, he said, is the only fruit that improves by being forgotten. He kept them in the dark under the stairs, nine boxes of them, and took one out on Sundays.

Every ③ apple in that garden came from the same two trees, and he said that was why they all tasted of the same thing. Their ④ apple, the one the family ate and the one nobody sold, had a name in the village and no name anywhere else; an apple, my grandmother said, is a place before it is a fruit. She said you can taste a field, and everybody in the village knew which field.

My mother was ⑤ the apple of his eye, which my grandmother said was the only English phrase he ever used correctly. The ⑥ apple orchard, meaning the nine trees behind the wall and not the two in front, was measured every autumn; an apple, he said, is the only tree that tells you how its year was.

She made ⑦ apple pie on Sundays for nine years and never once wrote the recipe down, and it died with her in 1984. By 1966 ⑧ apple trees had gone in along the whole lane, nine of them, and the village smelt of them for a month; an apple, my father said, is the only thing that everybody plants and nobody counts. He counted them once, in 1970, and stopped at nine, and never said why.

The ⑨ apple I remember is one my grandfather cut in half in 1963, to show me the nine seeds. An ⑩ apple, he said, is a fruit with a plan inside it, and the plan is not about you; every apple, he said, is a letter written to somebody who has not been born.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: C. n. 苹果（家中自吃的那个品种）
D. 固定搭配：the apple of one's eye 掌上明珠
E. 固定搭配：an apple orchard 苹果园
F. 固定搭配：apple pie 苹果派
G. n. （复数）苹果树；成片的苹果树
H. n. 苹果（抽象总称；泛指这种果实）

items.q: an apple tree behind the wall
The apple, meaning the fruit and not the tree
apple trees had gone in along the whole lane

answers.why: apple tree 意为“苹果树”，1958 年祖父在墙后种下一棵苹果树，说它会活得比他长。
apple 意为“苹果（果实）”，指果子而不是树，那种苹果又小又硬，能放到三月。
apple 意为“苹果（果实）”，园里每一个苹果都出自同样的两棵树，所以味道都一样。
apple 指家中自吃的那个品种，家里人吃、从不卖的那种苹果，在村里有名字，别处没有。
the apple of one's eye 意为“掌上明珠”，母亲是他的掌上明珠，祖母说那是他唯一用对的英语短语。
apple orchard 意为“苹果园”，指墙后那九棵树，而不是前面那两棵，每年秋天都要量一次。
apple pie 意为“苹果派”，她做了九年苹果派，从来没把配方写下来。
apple trees 为复数，意为“苹果树们”，到 1966 年整条巷子都种上了苹果树，一共九棵。
apple 意为“苹果（果实）”，我记得的是 1963 年祖父切成两半、给我看那九粒籽的那一个。
apple 为抽象总称，泛指“苹果这种果实”，他说苹果是一种里面带着计划的水果，而那计划与你无关。
